notes:
Background: small-to-mid developer platform that sells a hosted PR assistant for enterprise customers. Primary product is a VS Code extension + GitHub App that runs PR triage and suggests comments. Wants low-latency streaming in-IDE (sub-200ms token start), deterministic model pinning across environments, and on-device-like privacy guarantees for customer repos.

Key asks / requirements:
- Low-latency streaming for line-by-line diff summaries and inline comment generation (IDE experience should feel realtime).
- Model/version pinning: ability to pin a specific model + quantization profile for a customer POC and lock during rollouts.
- Reranking API: need an efficient reranker for comment suggestions so top-3 suggestions are high precision.
- Prefix/KV cache persistence between close-in-time PR edits; avoid reprocessing whole repo repeatedly.
- Cost controls: want suggestions for batching and quantization to hit $/PR targets.
- Security: VPC option, KMS for keys, audit logs for generated output, SSO/SAML for access control. Data residency for EU customers.

Quotes/voice notes: "If we can get streaming to feel instant in VS Code, adoption will skyrocket. Can't accept a 1.5s lag on every comment." — Head of Product.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- PR hunk summary latency median < 400ms for hunks <= 200 LOC (stream start < 200ms).
- Inline comment generation precision > 75% on manual eval set (internal benchmark).
- Ability to pin a model and roll back automatically if regression detected.

Other details / internal constraints:
- They run CI in GCP us-central (prefer Redwood region same).
- Will want a canary rollout when moving from hosted to dedicated; comfortable starting hosted API.
- Legal wants clear term in contract about not persisting customer code beyond cache TTL (they prefer ephemeral KV caching under 24 hours).
